description: This file defines an abstract class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter used for creating chainable URI filters in the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties for filter identification and configuration, as well as an abstract method for filtering URIs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter
classes.description: An abstract class representing a chainable filter for URI processing, allowing custom actions like transformation or blacklisting.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Performs initialization for the filter; returns true by default.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Abstract method to filter a URI object; to be implemented by subclasses.
